verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury is a banking/financial-accounts API (fiat/USDC balances, OutboundPayments, ReceivedDebits, transaction ledger) with automatic fraud controls that run in the background, but there is no evidence of a user-facing automation framework (rules engines, scheduled workflows, or AI-agent-configurable triggers) that an AI-native user could set up to run autonomously. The mentioned MCP server (probe-4) applies to Stripe broadly, not to a Treasury-specific automation-building capability.
